- **Presence reports runtime-authored turn activity, liveness beats and metadata-only turn summaries.** Persistent cron and Discord turns pass through one bob-owned FIFO admission: origin and prompt start together, the origin is held until the admitted prompt settles (bob#229), and shutdown closes admission before stopping scheduling. A turn outside admission is `run`. Discord replies remain attached to their own inbound admission. Presence replaces the heartbeat placeholder; beats and summaries carry no prompt, model or tool text.
